additional_info.subject: case notes
additional_info.body:
Customer have reported issues with the charger Friday.
First it was in failsafe mode after rebooting it charged 3 times and then it went offline and the charger shout down .
Went to site today to investigate.
Charger was all OK, however when charging I noticed a very high sound coming from the charger. Please listen to attached sound file.
I found that the sound was emanating from TB5, after disconnecting the converter the sound was not there anymore.
The charger have been working since I disconnected the converter
So I expect that the converter needs to be replaced under warranty.

Following your request, please proceed with the following steps to address the converter issue: check the  Cancommloss  that is connected to that converter. If it is attached correctly, move to the next step.
Try swapping the converter that shows the issue with the one beside it, just to confirm whether the problem is the Cancommloss or the converter.
If the issue remains after swapping, it confirms that the converter itself is faulty. In that case, replace the converter.
